text: Implemented map/projector algebra in modules/multivar: MvMap, IdentityMap, MatrixMap, ComposedMap, RestrictedMap, Decoder, PseudoInverseSolver capability, Projector, ComponentScale, and BiProjection. Added law tests for identity, projection equals preprocessing then weights, restriction, composition, explicit decoder capability, and projector/fit contract. Verified with sbt "multivarJVM/test" "multivarJS/test"; both passed 20 tests. git diff --check passed for modules/multivar.
